title: Inconsistent off-by-one errors with column numbers

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body: Reported after scrooloose/syntastic#1494 was closed. I have replicated the behavior with eslint `v1.0.0-rc-3` and `v1.0.0`. ``` bash 0:11:[greg:~/Dev/github/spectcl]$ eslint lib/spectcl.js lib/spectcl.js 10:44 error Extra semicolon semi ✖ 1 problem (1 error, 0 warnings) 1:12:[greg:~/Dev/github/spectcl]$ head lib/spectcl.js | tail -1 var spawn = require('child_process').spawn; 0:13:[greg:~/Dev/github/spectcl]$ eslint --version v1.0.0 ``` When using vim, it highlights the column **after** the semicolon as shown in the screenshot below: Note that I have no trailing spaces in the above example. Below, I have a trailing space on line 3, and I have `:set list` turned on in vim so that you may see the space. As you can see, trailing spaces are reported to be one column greater than they should be, same with semi, and the indent rule sometimes shows the correct column and sometimes shows off-by-one. I have tried with `} else { ...` on line 18 below, but still get the same off-by-one, so it's not due to the error being on the last character of a line. Code: ``` js 'use strict' /* * spectcl.js: Top-level include for the `spectcl` module. * * (C) 2015, Greg Cochard, Ryan Milbourne * (C) 2011, Elijah Insua, Marak Squires, Charlie Robbins. * */ var spawn = require('child_process').spawn; var util = require('util') var AssertionError = require('assert').AssertionError var EventEmitter = require('events').EventEmitter function testExpectation(data, expectation) { if (util.isRegExp(expectation)) { return expectation.test(data) } ``` Errors: ``` lib/spectcl.js|3 col 60 error| Trailing spaces not allowed. (no-trailing-spaces) lib/spectcl.js|10 col 44 error| Extra semicolon. (semi) lib/spectcl.js|11 col 3 error| Expected indentation of 0 characters. (indent) lib/spectcl.js|18 col 4 error| Expected indentation of 4 characters. (indent) ``` Config file follows: ``` json { "env": {"node": true}, "globals": {}, "extends": "eslint:recommended", "rules": { "no-extra-parens": 2, "no-unexpected-multiline": 2, "valid-jsdoc": 2, "default-case": 2, "dot-notation": 2, "eqeqeq": 2, "no-alert": 2, "no-caller": 2, "no-else-return": 2, "no-empty-label": 2, "no-eval": 2, "no-extend-native": 2, "no-floating-decimal": 2, "no-implied-eval": 2, "no-iterator": 2, "no-lone-blocks": 2, "no-loop-func": 2, "no-multi-spaces": 2, "no-multi-str": 2, "no-native-reassign": 2, "no-new-func": 2, "no-new-wrappers": 2, "no-new": 2, "no-octal-escape": 2, "no-proto": 2, "no-return-assign": 2, "no-self-compare": 2, "no-throw-literal": 2, "no-unused-expressions": 2, "no-warning-comments": 2, "no-with": 2, "radix": 2, "strict": [2, "global"], "no-shadow-restricted-names": 2, "no-shadow": 2, "no-undef-init": 2, "no-use-before-define": 2, "callback-return": 2, "handle-callback-err": 2, "no-mixed-requires": 2, "no-new-require": 2, "no-path-concat": 2, "no-process-exit": 2, "no-sync": 2, "camelcase": 2, "consistent-this": [2, "self"], "indent": 2, "linebreak-style": 2, "new-cap": 2, "new-parens": 2, "no-array-constructor": 2, "no-fallthrough": 1, "no-multiple-empty-lines": [2, {"max": 2}], "no-nested-ternary": 2, "no-new-object": 2, "no-trailing-spaces": 2, "quotes": [2, "single", "avoid-escape"], "semi": [2, "never"], "space-return-throw-case": 2, "spaced-comment": [2, "always", {"exceptions": ["=","-"]}] } } ```
